target_column.description: Name of the regression target column.

max_train_rows.description: Operational cap on fitted support rows.

validation_split.description: Random holdout fraction when val.csv is absent.

fine_tune.description: Must remain false. TabDPT v1.2 uses in-context fitting; no gradient fine-tuning is performed.

n_ensembles.description: Prediction ensemble members used for validation/inference.

context_size.description: Maximum support rows used per ensemble member.

batch_size.description: Evaluation batch size; reduce when GPU memory is constrained.

seed.description: Seed for splitting, support sampling, and feature permutations.
